market_outlook.short_term: ASX200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Iron ore weakness caps materials; oil spike supports energy but is offset by fuel-cost inflation and Fed hike risk. Housing softness drags REITs and financials. Expect volatility around Fed decision and RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Structural iron ore demand shift and China policy pivot cap mining multiples. Energy transition and critical-mines theme offers selective upside. Housing correction may deepen, pressuring financials. AI capex debate and immigration policy overhaul create uncertainty. Superannuation reform debate could reshape long-term capital flows.
